name: Yashima Denki Co., Ltd.
summary: Yashima Denki Co., Ltd. engages in the plant, public/facilities, and transportation businesses in Japan and internationally. It provides plants solutions to petroleum, chemical, pharmaceuticals, and precision equipment manufacturing industries, as well as steel and non-ferrous metals plant sector. It also operates public/facilities business, which includes social and public systems, air conditioning solutions, construction, data center solutions, and office environment solutions; and transportation business, such as vehicle, power substation, information and communications, and machinery and equipment.
